text: I'm working on the first queued ticket: record the "stay on `localhost`, not a native app" decision (#411). Next I'll check the MEMORY.md format rules, then make the two small doc edits.

I did the first task on the queue, ticket #411 ("App instead of `localhost`?"), and published it as PR #1787 (https://github.com/framework/the-framework/pull/1787). It is set to merge on its own once its checks pass.

The maintainer had already decided on GitHub: keep the dashboard as a page on `localhost` for now, because the users are developers. All that was left was writing that down, and there are no code changes:
- **`MEMORY.md`:** a new decision entry. The dashboard is a page on `localhost`, not a native app. Non-technical users will most likely use the hosted version, and a native app may come later alongside `localhost`.
- **`VISION.md`:** a native app for the dashboard is added to the "Postponed" list, linked to #411, so the idea isn't lost.

The ticket's plan also said to comment on #411 and close it by hand. Instead, the PR body says "Closes #411", so the issue closes when the PR merges.

I only kept the parts of the thread the maintainer actually said, following the `MEMORY.md` format rules. The plan's extra reasons (the Chrome extension depending on `localhost`, and preferring Tauri over Electron) came from code reading and other comments, so I left them out.

The ticket is closed and its queue entry is marked done. Closing the ticket also removed my claim on it, and the branch is clean and pushed.
